title: AURA: composition-dependent context variance model for spatial transcriptomics
description: AURA tests and quantifies how gene expression in a focal cell type depends on the continuous composition of its local neighborhood in single-cell-resolution spatial transcriptomics data (Xenium, CosMx, cell-segmented Visium HD), separating this from cell-level transcriptional output and flagging transcript spillover. This release (v0.2.0) is the version used in the Genome Biology revision and includes the scripts that reproduce all revision analyses.
